cases.case_label: 1.5 kb L1 fragment in exon 10 of GYS2
cases.mechanism_detail: A paternally inherited 1.5-kb L1 fragment inserted in GYS2 exon 10 (in trans with p.Pro479Gln) likely causes the observed 79-bp skipping of exon 10 (r.1230_1308del), producing a frameshift and NMD-mediated reduction of GYS2 mRNA.
cases.quote: This insertion likely causes the 79 bp skipping of exon 10 (previously observed) and the subsequent degradation of the aberrant mRNA due to the existence of a frameshift.

cases.case_label: 2.6 kb SVA in intron 8 of PEX1
cases.mechanism_detail: A 2.6-kb SVA in PEX1 intron 8, in trans with c.2097dup, is associated with allele-specific expression (reduced expression of the SVA allele); a possible pseudoexon insertion is proposed but not demonstrated.
cases.quote: From the TE insertions, two were located in the genomic region of GYS2 or PEX1, causing a reduction in their mRNA expression.

cases.case_label: 2.5 kb L1 7.6 kb downstream of SLC2A1
cases.mechanism_detail: A 2.5-kb L1 inserted 7.6 kb downstream of SLC2A1 rewires 3D chromatin: 4C-seq in patient fibroblasts shows strongly reduced contacts between the SLC2A1 promoter and its 5' distal cis-regulatory element cluster (new loop to the TAD 3' border), with SLC2A1 expression ~20% of normal.
cases.quote: it alters the interaction between the SLC2A1 promoter and its distal regulatory element via the establishment of a loop with the 3’ border of the native topologically associating domain
